title: Poisonous Slime Bomb

sources.title: Poison Cloud
markers: it's the DC of the player character

summary: Throw for an immediate Poison burst and a 10-turn cloud that can Poison creatures.

fields.Throw: Action, single use, 60 ft range. Deal 1d4 + 1 Poison to creatures in a small radius and create a 10 ft radius Poison Cloud for 10 turns.
fields.Poison Cloud: The cloud does no damage. Creatures inside make a Constitution save each turn against the thrower’s DC or become Poisoned for 1 turn. Poisoned gives disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks.
fields.Acquisition: Unique Auntie Ethel drop. No ordinary vendor or alchemy recipe.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay details with pinned item and linked rules evidence.
